findings.label: Unnecessary sw.js CACHE_NAME bump requested in the handoff
findings.detail: The doc states CACHE_NAME must be bumped from prezenty-v120 for the new CSS to reach installed clients. public/sw.js uses a cache-first strategy with caches.match(event.request) and no ignoreSearch, so chat-reactions.css?v=3 can match neither the precached unversioned /chat-reactions.css nor the previously cached ?v=2 entry - it always goes to the network and is then cached under the new key. The ?v= bump alone delivers the CSS; drop the request so a downstream step does not do needless work. The unversioned /chat-reactions.css precache entry is dead weight for the same reason.

findings.label: Vertical hit slop still overhangs the bubble above (carried over from the reactions pass)
findings.detail: .chat-reaction-add::after keeps height: 44px with top: 50% / translateY(-50%) on a 32px-tall button, so 6px extends above the button box and ~2px into the bubble above it (.chat-reactions has margin-top: 4px). The pseudo-element is in a positioned context, so it can absorb a tap on a link on the bubble's last line - exactly non-blocking finding 2 of the reactions review, which is still open. The verification doc describes the remaining slop as extending 'below the strip', which understates it. Fix: asymmetric top/height, or raise .chat-reactions margin-top to 6px.

findings.label: Add circle no longer flush with the row's right edge
findings.detail: The button's 44px box now sits on the from-me row's right edge, so the visible 32px circle is inset ~6px from the bubble and chips above it (reported as a ~12px shift at 1024px). Cosmetic and documented; accept, or pull it back with a negative margin if the asymmetry reads as a bug.

findings.label: URLs wrap rather than ellipsize
findings.detail: .chat-bubble a { word-break: break-all } was deliberately kept, so a long URL wraps across lines instead of being ellipsized, against the task's stated 'URLs prefer ellipsis' preference. Measured at zero overflow at 320px, so the overflow requirement is met either way; the rationale (a URL is often the entire message) is recorded. Confirm the product preference if ellipsis was a hard requirement.

findings.label: .container { overflow-x: hidden } left in the shared stylesheet
findings.detail: Correctly reported rather than edited, per the shared-stylesheet constraint. It still makes every .container on every page a scroll container (overflow-y computes to auto) and silently clips instead of scrolling - it is what hid the +288px thread-row overflow. Needs a follow-up change that is allowed to touch shared CSS: drop it or switch to overflow-x: clip, then re-measure the dependent pages and bump the cache busters.

findings.label: Undocumented app-theme.css cache-buster bump
findings.detail: app-theme.css?v=13 -> ?v=14 brings the page in line with the other nine pages and app-theme.css itself is unmodified, so it is harmless, but it is not recorded in the verification doc's change tables.
